params.description: ID or slug of the target segment. **Required** if target field is not supplied.

params.name: use_scores
params.description: Include raw behavioral scores as features in the model (usually very useful).

params.name: target_field
params.description: Slug of the target field. Cannot provide both a target and a target field, hence required if target segment is not indicated (see above).

params.name: use_content
params.description: If true, include content affinities as features in the model.

params.name: aspect_collections
params.description: List of Segment Collections to include in the model.  Possible values are "email", "web", "support", "mobile", "commerce", "behaviors", "content".

params.name: additional_fields
params.description: List of additional user fields to include in the model.

params.name: model_only
params.description: Build the model without scoring each user. This is useful during model building exercises when comparing efficiency and accuracy between models. Set true by default unless **evalonly** is selected.

params.name: eval_only
params.description: If true, a previously built model is used to rescore users. Only the source and target parameters are needed in the API call to to identify which model to use.

params.name: auto_tune
params.description: If true, enable auto-tune feature selection.

params.name: tune_model
params.description: If true, model tuning parameters are optimized before any models are built. Experimental.

params.name: tags
params.description: Includes tags to be associated with the model.

params.name: re_run
params.description: If true, re-run the model every week.

params.name: save_segments
params.description:
If true, this saves three different segments:
    1) Users from source and target segments who "look like" users from the target segment.
    2) Users not in the target segment.
    3) Users from the source segment who look like users from the target segment.

params.name: as_is
params.description: If true, do not remove any of the model features when creating the model.

params.name: num_to_train
params.description: The number of samples to collect from both the source and target segment for feature matrices.  Defaults to 5,000.

params.name: cor_threshold
params.description: Threshold (0.0-1.0) at which to remove correlated features.

{
